stem: A team wants to correct poor propagation performance by changing media, humidity strategy, and an input at the same time. What is the strongest Technician II objection?
choices: Three changes are always cheaper than one
Multiple simultaneous changes make it difficult to determine which factor caused improvement or decline; use controlled, authorized changes and verify response
Only genotype records matter in propagation
rationale: Controlled troubleshooting preserves causal information. Changing several factors simultaneously weakens the ability to verify which correction affected performance.
